result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial Story 0 verification covered FC-0.1 through FC-0.7, the foundation module scaffold, fail-closed SDK and CLI stubs, fixture builders, token counting, boundary and gate scripts, direct focused probes, and configured story/epic gates.

newFindings.title: Configured gates fail during test typecheck
newFindings.evidence: `pnpm --dir /Users/leemoore/code/pi-long-horizon/liminal-context/packages/lhc run green-verify` and `pnpm --dir /Users/leemoore/code/pi-long-horizon/liminal-context/packages/lhc run verify-all` both exited 2 in `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Errors: `test/fixtures.test.ts:60` unused `@ts-expect-error`; `test/fixtures.test.ts:62` invalid `toolCallId` property for `{ text: string }`; `test/fixtures/index.ts:47` unsafe conversion to `EventByKind<K>`. Because `red-verify` fails, FC-0.1, FC-0.2, and the configured story gate are not satisfied.

newFindings.title: Gate self-test proof is still missing
newFindings.evidence: FC-0.7 requires proof that a sacrificial failing test fails `verify` and an edited Red-phase test file fails `green-verify`. The implementor artifact reports these self-tests were not performed. Current `green-verify` fails before reaching `check-test-immutability`, and `node packages/lhc/scripts/check-test-immutability.mjs` exits 0 with `test-immutability: no Red-phase manifest; nothing to check` because `packages/lhc/test/red-manifest.json` is absent. That does not establish the edited-Red-file failure proof.
